requirements.text: The system shall ensure compliance with data protection regulations while maintaining transparency in attendance recording.
The system shall allow students to dispute attendance records within 10 days of marking.
The system shall generate anonymized attendance reports for administrators to protect student identities.
The system shall notify students of their attendance status within 24 hours of a class.
The system shall implement a combined role-based access control and logging of access attempts.
The system shall maintain historical attendance data for five years to comply with educational regulations.
The system shall ensure secure authentication and data encryption to protect attendance data.
The system shall provide real-time data synchronization and processing to maintain accurate attendance records.
The system shall implement automated alerts for discrepancies and maintain an audit log for accountability.
The system shall allow students to view their attendance records after successful authentication.
The system shall provide a mechanism for users to report unauthorized access or data breaches.
The system shall combine load balancing with energy-efficient operations to optimize resource use.
The system shall undergo regular security audits to identify and mitigate potential vulnerabilities.
